my.title: My leave
my.description: Your balances and requests. Balances are per calendar year.
my.emptyDescription: When you apply for leave it shows up here with its approval status.

apply.title: Apply for leave
apply.description: Working days are calculated live — weekends and public holidays are excluded unless the leave type counts them.
apply.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB.
apply.fileHintRequired: PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB — required for this request.
apply.summaryEmpty: Pick a leave type and dates to see how many working days you're requesting and what's left afterwards.

approvals.title: Leave approvals
approvals.description: Requests waiting for you — as line manager, delegate or HR. Select several to approve in bulk.
approvals.emptyDescription: New leave requests from your team will appear here.
approvals.bulkApproveTitle: Approve {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}?
approvals.bulkRejectTitle: Reject {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}?
approvals.bulkDescription: Each employee is notified. Cancellation requests in the selection are decided the same way.

delegations.title: Delegation
delegations.description: Away? Let a colleague approve leave for your team during a period. HR can always step in.

settings.title: Leave settings
settings.description: UAE defaults are pre-loaded as editable starting points — nothing is hard-coded.

policies.intro: Override the entitlement or eligibility for a group. When several match, the most specific wins (position › department › employment type).
policies.emptyDescription: Everyone gets the leave type defaults.

holidays.emptyDescription: Add them one by one or copy last year's and adjust the lunar dates.
holidays.lunarNote: Islamic holidays depend on moon sighting — update the dates once they are officially announced. Existing requests keep their calculated days.

general.approvalsDescription: The work week used for counting leave days is set in Company settings.
general.escalationHint: Approvers get a reminder when a request waits this long; at the next reminder, manager steps are escalated to HR.

typeDialog.prorateHint: By the remaining days of the year
typeDialog.paidHint: Unpaid days are deducted in payroll
typeDialog.encashable: Pay out unused balance in the final settlement
typeDialog.approvalChainHint: Steps run in order. With no steps, requests are approved automatically.

policyDialog.appliesTo: Applies to (all that are set must match)
policyDialog.eligible: Eligible (untick to exclude this group from the leave type)
policyDialog.changesNote: Changes apply to future accruals; credits already granted are not recalculated (adjust balances if needed).

holidayDialog.deleteDescription: Requests already submitted keep their calculated days.
holidayDialog.copyDescription: Same day and month. Lunar (Islamic) holidays move every year, so adjust them afterwards.

request.autoApproved: This leave type is approved automatically.
request.approverNotified: Your approver has been notified. You'll get a notification when it's decided.
request.balanceNote: {name}'s {type} balance for {year}: {available} days available after pending requests (incl. this one).

requests.descriptionTeam: Requests from your direct and indirect reports.

reports.title: Leave reports
reports.description: Approved leave taken between {from} and {to} (days are counted inside the period only).
reports.emptyTitle: No leave taken in this period

balances.title: Leave balances
balances.description: Per employee and leave type. Manual adjustments require a reason and are audited.

adjust.title: Adjust {type} balance
adjust.description: {name} · {year}. Use a negative number to deduct. The employee is notified and the change is audited.
adjust.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Compensation for working on public holiday

calendar.title: Leave calendar
calendar.description: Approved leave is solid, pending is striped. Weekends and public holidays are shaded.
calendar.noCalendarDescription: Your account is not linked to an employee record.

balanceCards.empty: No leave balances yet. Balances appear once you become eligible for a leave type.

actions.actingAsDelegate: You are acting as delegate for {name}.
actions.commentHint: Required when rejecting. Shared with the employee.
actions.withdrawDescription: Your approver will no longer see it. Days are released immediately.
actions.cancelDescription: Your approver needs to confirm. The days stay booked until they do.
actions.hrCancelDescription: The leave is cancelled immediately and the days are returned to the balance. The employee is notified and the action is audited.

ineligible.policy: Your leave policy does not include this leave type

errors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.

errors.noHalfDay: {type} cannot be taken as a half day.
errors.eligibleFrom: {type} can be used from {date} (after {months} months of service).
errors.beforeJoin: Leave cannot start before your join date.

errors.backdate: {type} can be backdated by at most {days} days.
errors.nothingToBook: The selected dates are all weekends or public holidays — there is nothing to book.
errors.maxConsecutive: {type} allows at most {days} days in one request.
errors.documentAbove: A supporting document is required for more than {days} days of {type}.
errors.negativeWarning: This takes your {type} balance for {year} to {days}.
errors.notEnough: Not enough {type} balance for {year}: {available} available, {requested} requested.
errors.colleaguesOff: {count, plural, one {# colleague is} other {# colleagues are}} also off during these dates.
errors.notLinked: Your account is not linked to an employee record.
errors.noLongerWaiting: This request is no longer waiting for a decision.
errors.notApprover: You are not an approver for this request.
errors.rejectReason: Please give a reason when rejecting.
errors.alreadyActed: Someone else has already acted on this request.
errors.onlyPendingWithdraw: Only pending requests can be withdrawn. Ask to cancel approved leave instead.
errors.onlyApprovedCancel: Only approved leave can be cancelled this way.
errors.alreadyEnded: This leave has already ended. Contact HR to correct past leave.
errors.ownLeaveHr: Use the normal cancellation flow for your own leave.
errors.ownBalance: You cannot adjust your own leave balance.
errors.zeroAdjustmentField: Enter a positive or negative number of days
errors.noBalanceEntitlement: Leave without a balance has no entitlement.
errors.noBalanceEntitlementField: Set to 0, or choose an accrual method
errors.codeUsedField: Another leave type uses this code
errors.policyTarget: A policy must target a department, position or employment type.
errors.unknownRefs: Unknown leave type, department or position.
errors.endDateField: Must be on or after the date
errors.holidayTooLong: A holiday can span at most 15 days.
errors.delegationOver: The delegation would already be over.
errors.delegationOverlap: You already have a delegation in that period.

toasts.rejectedCount: Rejected {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}.
toasts.approvedCountFailed: Approved {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} ({failed} failed).
toasts.rejectedCountFailed: Rejected {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} ({failed} failed).
